## Purpose

Draft definition of what the warranty covers after go-live.

## Scope

DRAFT — not agreed. Warranty period is PROPOSED. The prototype carries no warranty for production use.

## Definitions

Other terms: see **BM-GLO-001** (Project Glossary).

## 1. Proposed warranty

| Item | Proposal |
|---|---|
| Period | 90 days from production go-live |
| Covered | Defects where the system does not meet accepted requirements (UAT baseline) |
| Not covered | New requirements, changes after acceptance, third-party outages, misuse, infrastructure managed by others, data quality issues |
| Prototype | Provided for demonstration and requirement validation only — not for production use |
| Remedy | Correction or workaround per support severity levels (**BM-HND-014** (Support and Maintenance Agreement (Draft))) |

## 2. Exclusions related to known limitations

Limitations listed in **BM-HND-011** (Limitations Document — Prototype vs Production) are not defects of the prototype.
